result.summary: Adds `btck_witness_stack_to_bytes` to the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper, serializing a witness stack into its consensus byte representation via a writer callback. It also adds unit tests verifying empty and populated witness stack serialization in `test_kernel`.
result.problem: Reading all items of a witness stack through libbitcoinkernel requires calling `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` repeatedly, resulting in O(n²) retrieval costs. Callers currently have no single-call method to extract the full witness data without deserializing item by item.
evidence: PR description: "I agree the O(n²) cost of reading a whole witness with `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` needs fixing."
Proposed as an alternative approach to PR #36909 ("kernel: add btck_witness_stack_get_items"), matching existing `*_to_bytes` conventions in libbitcoinkernel.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff is now available; the implementation adds the C API function, C++ wrapper method `ToBytes()`, and test assertions matching the previous description.
result.card: Adds `btck_witness_stack_to_bytes` to the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper to export consensus-serialized witness stacks in a single call. Callers reading entire witness stacks item-by-item via `btck_witness_stack_get_item_at` currently incur O(n²) overhead. This PR addresses the issue as an alternative to PR #36909's callback iterator by adhering to the established `*_to_bytes` kernel API convention.

risk.why: A mistake in the serialization logic could deliver malformed witness byte streams to libbitcoinkernel consumers.
